---
name: RFC (Request for Comments)
about: Propose major architectural changes, schemas, or platform specifications
title: "[RFC] "
labels: ["rfc", "architecture"]
assignees: ""
---

## Summary
A brief 1-2 sentence overview of the architectural proposal.

## Motivation & Operational Goals
Why should we do this? What operational scenarios or platform limitations does this address?

## Proposed Architecture / Technical Design
Detailed technical design, including:
- Data models & telemetry schemas
- API / Interface boundaries
- Network communication models & latency considerations
- Swarm / multi-agent considerations

## Compatibility & Migration
How does this impact existing autopilot integrations (PX4, ArduPilot), ROS 2 nodes, or ground control interfaces?

## Drawbacks & Alternatives
- What are the trade-offs or complexities introduced?
- What alternative architectures were considered?

## Open Questions
Areas of the design that remain unresolved or require community feedback.
